tasks.requirement: 1 — requireAuth must enforce the Bearer prefix: header not starting with 'Bearer ' (case-sensitive, trailing space) returns 401
tasks.description: In requireAuth, check that req.headers.authorization starts with 'Bearer '; if not (or if header is absent) return 401. Extract the token as the substring after 'Bearer ' before passing it to isValidToken.

tasks.requirement: 3 — requireAuth must reject tokens longer than 200 characters with 401, before any digit-sum validation
tasks.description: After extracting the token (post-Bearer strip), check token.length > 200; if so return 401. This guard must execute before the isValidToken call.

tasks.requirement: 2 — isValidToken must not use eval(); rewrite using plain string/array operations that reproduce the digit-sum parity logic
tasks.description: Replace the eval()-based implementation with: (token.match(/\d/g) ?? []).reduce((s, n) => s + parseInt(n, 10), 0) % 2 === 0. The function signature and return type remain the same.

tasks.requirement: 4 — productController must not import or call child_process.exec()
tasks.description: Remove the `import { exec } from 'child_process'` line and the exec(...) audit-log call from getProducts. The handler should only call parseProductQuery, productService.getAllProducts, and return the response.
